gaps.description: Write the product hooks in src/modules/video-lifecycle/video-lifecycle-lifecycle-writer.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and a message that reaches one ends in its queue's .failed.
Write the product hooks in src/modules/view-counter/view-counter-receipt-and-increment.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and a message that reaches one ends in its queue's .failed.
Write the product hooks in src/modules/account-api/account-api-favorite-videos.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and adding an item answers 501.
Write View count reader in src/modules/watch-api/watch-api-view-count-reader.ts; its stub throws "Not implemented".
Write View publisher in src/modules/watch-api/watch-api-view-publisher.ts; its stub throws "Not implemented".
Write the product hooks in src/modules/upload-api/upload-api-multipart-uploads.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and its route answers 501.
Write the product hooks in src/modules/watch-api/watch-api-video-details-cache.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and its route answers 501.

Write the product hooks in src/modules/search-api/search-api-video-search.hooks.ts, src/modules/search-indexer/search-indexer-index-writer.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and a search answers 501 and each event goes to .failed.
Write the product hooks in src/modules/transcoder/transcoder-segmenter-and-encoder.hooks.ts; until then each throws "Not implemented" and a message that reaches one ends in its queue's .failed.

implementations.description: Finite asset/job identity shared by lifecycle and video dependencies.
Fixed asset lifecycle, upload hooks, result receipts and optional committed publication dependency.
Normalized binding inventory only; implements no application behavior or setting consumer.
Transaction, bound outbox relay and receipt-with-effect dependency libraries only.
Receipt-based one-event increments, public totals and bound consumer dependency.
Each signed-in account's favorite items in one template-owned table, with bounded add, check, remove and paged list.
Standalone exact local project, selected providers and least-privilege setup; no domain features.
Bound storage/queue video execution, immutable marker reuse and confirmed results.
Typed module stubs; every entry point is custom work and throws until written.
Owned signed multipart engine, S3 adapter and explicitly mounted HTTP handlers.
Positive-only immutable lookup, single-flight, bounded cache fallback and explicit adapter bindings.
Reusable HTTP, verified identity, confirmed messaging and resource clients only.
Explicit public projection/versioned upsert and bounded query dependencies.
A runnable process per application tile: HTTP routes and consume loops for its templates and stubs, the public edge, ready marker and graceful shutdown.
Owned transfer repository and transaction-bound metadata/completion hooks only.
Reusable selected-resource constructors; application policy and services remain custom.
Fixed CPU video probe, HLS, full-size thumbnail and bound inventory dependency.
